description: This file contains declarations for utility functions, constants, and data structures used in the LibXDiff library for file differencing. It includes function prototypes for hashing, diff record emission, line analysis, and memory management related to diff computations.

methods.name: xdl_bogosqrt
methods.description: Calculates an approximate square root using a bogo algorithm.

methods.name: xdl_emit_diffrec
methods.description: Emits a diff record, likely for output or processing.

methods.name: xdl_cha_init
methods.description: Initializes a chastore structure for diff computations.

methods.name: xdl_cha_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a chastore.

methods.name: xdl_guess_lines
methods.description: Estimates the number of lines in a memory-mapped file.

methods.name: xdl_blankline
methods.description: Checks if a line is blank.

methods.name: xdl_recmatch
methods.description: Checks if two records match based on certain flags.

methods.name: xdl_hash_record_verbatim
methods.description: Hashes a record verbatim, including whitespace.

methods.name: xdl_hash_record_with_whitespace
methods.description: Hashes a record considering whitespace differences.

methods.name: xdl_num_out
methods.description: Outputs a number to a string buffer.

methods.name: xdl_emit_hunk_hdr
methods.description: Emits a diff hunk header for output.

methods.name: xdl_alloc_grow_helper
methods.description: Helper function for growing allocated memory.

methods.name: uint64_t xdl_hash_record(uint8_t const ** data,uint8_t const * top,uint64_t flags)

ctags.name: xdl_hash_record
ctags.pattern: /^static inline uint64_t xdl_hash_record(uint8_t const **data, uint8_t const *top, uint64_t flags)$/
